question: What mantra element should be spoken after the epithet of the ash-adorned body?
premises: The epithet to the ash-adorned body is included.
After that the word ghaṇṭā is to be spoken.
inference: One should say the word ghaṇṭā after the phrase to the ash-adorned body.
plain_english: After saying ‘to the one whose body is adorned with ash’, one should say the word ‘ghaṇṭā’.
